result: Deliverables 2 and 4 are met and I found no blockers. `mise run verify` passes, dist is in sync, and every new test fails without its change.

changed: none

checks:
- `bunx --no-install mise run verify` in the worktree -> exit 0. Type-check clean, lint clean (135 files), fmt clean (267 files), tests 1140 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail.
- `bunx --no-install mise run build` on a `git archive ca1d774` copy with `node_modules` symlinked -> `diff -rq` against the worktree's `packages/integrations/claude/dist` shows no difference. `plugin.test.ts` also has a byte-for-byte dist check.
- Parent run: I copied the three changed test files onto a `001a77d` archive.
  - `design-skills.test.ts` and `plugin.test.ts` fail to load, because `embedMateriality` and `MATERIALITY_FILE` do not exist there.
  - `sessioncontext.test.ts` fails on "Briefs hold literal absolute paths.".
- Mutation runs on the ca1d774 copy, each caught by a test:
  - a restated definition phrase in a root source fails "restated by no other source";
  - a marker with trailing whitespace fails "carries whole", "no marker line" and the requirements-reach test;
  - a removed marker fails "carries whole";
  - an extra marker in another source fails "no marker line";
  - a removed dispatch sentence fails the sessioncontext and visual-judging tests.

Not run: whether the host expands `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in agent text and in the session-start hook. I read `hook.ts:220-229`, which does the substitution for hook context, so the root sees a real path to put in briefs. Only instruction text and tests cover this.

blockers: none

findings (ranked, all non-blocking):
1. `packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts:188-193`: `embedMateriality` matches the marker only as an exact whole line.
   - A marker with whitespace or a typo, in a new source, ships as an inert comment with no build failure.
   - The three current sources are covered by the tests: the mutation run above confirmed the trailing-space case.
   - The error is a plain `Error`, but `vendor.ts` does the same, so this matches the build code around it.
   - Smallest fix: match with `line.trim()`.
2. `packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/roles/reviewer-visual/captures.md:1`: the "list the paths of the final captures" sentence sits in a paragraph about targets other than a web page.
   - A live-inspected web page may leave the root's final pass nothing to read.
   - Smallest fix: one clause saying that a web page inspected live is covered by Worker.visual or Worker.operations saving captures.
3. `docs/pi/claude-parity.md:49` still says visual work is accepted on Reviewer.visual's evidence. The commit reverses that.
   - Smallest fix: update the row.

notes:
- Budget: `ROOT_CORE` is 6033 characters. The fixed parts (`ROOT_CORE`, `ROOT_TAKEOVER`, `CLOUD_IDENTITY`, `SESSION_REMINDER`) total 7717 against the test cap of 8300, which is `CONTEXT_BUDGET` minus 1000. That leaves 583 characters of headroom in that test. This commit adds about 36 characters to the core (the dispatch sentence). The guard test is passing and the cap works as designed, so the headroom is not a defect. I could not reproduce your "41 characters" figure, so it may come from a different test.
- The code-review findings on `visual-judging` (unbounded root image reading, absolute plugin path) are design choices for the artifact reviewer; the `tui-design` "(default)" marks follow the shared-core number rule.
